literal_meaning: দাঁতে কুটো বা ছেদ করা (to make a notch or cut in the teeth)
figurative_meaning_en: To humbly accept subjugation or submission
example_sentences_in_bangla: দাঁতে কুটো করে বলল, আর কখনো এমন ভুল হবে না।
সে দাঁতে কুটো করার মতো করে ক্ষমা চাইল।
example_sentences_in_english: He made a notch in his teeth, promising it won't happen again.
She submitted humbly, begging for forgiveness like biting her teeth.
history: This idiom originates from rural Bengali customs where making a notch in one's teeth symbolized a solemn promise or acceptance of defeat to avoid further conflict.
note: The idiom reflects traditional practices of marking personal commitments through physical symbols.
